verdict.rationale: Square provides official SDKs across multiple languages (e.g., square-nodejs-sdk on GitHub), a documented Mobile Payments SDK, and comprehensive API docs (catalog, inventory, orders, payments, webhooks, sandbox testing), plus a specification-driven client generation approach (connect-api-specification). This directly supports building AI-native or programmatic integrations against official SDKs. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of SDK quality/maintenance and explicit developer testimonials on SDK usability beyond payments/hardware discussions.
